name: Lila Snowell
source: Originally from the Yuki Onna tribe, she is now the receptionist of the guild "Alshark" found in the school.  She also sells miscellaneous goods in the guild, and it is a place where the [url=/c94631]protagonist[/url] often visits to see her boobs.  She looks cold at first glance, but she's a friendly and easy to talk to person. For some reason, she often recommends quests that are ethically difficult, such as the "subjugation of female orcs in heat" quest, which she recommends to the protagonist. Because she is a Yuki-Onna, she is not good with hot temperatures and hot food. Her mind starts to melt and she goes into heat when she stays in a hot place for a long time.
